# Rental income tax

The flat: Flat 3, 22 Cardigan Road, Headingley, LS6. One bed, second floor. My home before the kids, let since August 2016. Owned in my sole name, so all the profit is taxed on me at 40%. (Should it have been joint with Javier? Probably. Too late without stamp duty and CGT headaches.)

## Tenant and agent

- Tenant: Marek Nowak, since 1 March 2022. Rent £925/month from March 2024 (was £875). Pays on the 1st, never late. Treasure him.
- Agent: Hollins Lettings, Otley Road. Fully managed, 10% + VAT = 12% of rent. Statements numbered HL-YYMM-NNN.
- Deposit £1,010, protected with the DPS, certificate DPS-118274.

## 2023/24 figures

| | £ |
|---|---|
| Rent received (11 × 875 + 1 × 925) | 10,550 |

Minus the £120 I somehow missed and found later on the Screwfix receipt (silicone, trim) = **£6,876**, that's what went on the return in [[Self assessment 2024]].

## Section 24, the painful bit

Mortgage interest is not deducted from rental profit any more. Instead there's a tax credit of 20% of the finance costs.

- Paragon BTL, interest only, £118,000 at 5.24% from Sept 2023. Interest 2023/24: £5,903 (part year at the old 2.09% rate, then the new one)
- Credit: 20% × 5,903 = £1,180.60
- Tax on profit at 40%: £2,750.40
- Net tax on the flat: £1,569.80

If interest were deductible like it used to be: (6,876 - 5,903) × 40% = £389.20. So Section 24 costs me £1,180 a year. As a basic-rate taxpayer it would make no difference, which is the whole design.

Cash reality: rent £10,550, minus costs £3,554, minus interest £5,903 = £1,093 profit in actual money, before tax of £1,569.80. **The flat lost me £477 in 2023/24 after tax.** Writing that down so I stop pretending otherwise.

## What's allowable, quick list

- Repairs that restore (yes), improvements (no, capital, added to base cost for CGT later)
- Replacement of domestic items relief: like-for-like replacement of furniture, white goods. Replaced the fridge freezer Feb 2024, £329, claimed
- Travel to the flat: mileage at 45p if I go for a landlord reason. 3 trips, 8 miles round trip. £10.80. Petty but it's mine
- Not allowable: my own time, the original purchase costs, the mortgage capital

## Damp

The mould treatment in Nov 2023 (£285 from Aire Valley Damp, invoice AVD-3302) was a repair. The proper fix with a new humidistat fan (£203) also a repair since the old fan was there and failed. My notes on the same problem at home are in [[Damp in the bathroom]].

## Making Tax Digital

MTD for income tax from April 2026 if gross income from self-employment plus property is over £50,000. Mine is about £82,000 combined, so I'm in the first wave. Quarterly updates, through FreeAgent. Deadlines in [[Tax deadline calendar]].

## Options I keep circling

1. Sell. CGT at 24% on the gain since 2011 purchase (£139,500 to maybe £205,000). Minus £3,000 allowance, minus lettings relief (none, I wasn't sharing). Rough tax £13,700.
2. Keep, and move to joint ownership with Javier by declaration of trust, 25/75. Possible stamp duty if there's a mortgage share transferred. Ask a solicitor.
3. Keep as is and grumble.

Currently: option 3. The insurance side is in [[Landlord insurance]].
